_comment: End-to-end agent questions for SuSchedule-r. Each item has a checkable assertion: `must_contain` = substrings (case-insensitive) the grounded answer should include (ALL required); `any_of` = at least one must appear. `must_not` = substrings that would indicate a hallucination. Ground truth taken from the SU catalog (credits, prereqs, topics). Run through scheduler.session.PlannerSession in react mode with transcript_cagan.json loaded.

questions.q: How many SU credits is CS 412?
What are the prerequisites for CS 301?
What is the prerequisite for CS 307?
Does CS 411 require a math prerequisite, and which one?
Is CS 412 a machine learning course?
Recommend one theoretical computer science elective I could take.
